# FeruzDev toolkit

> Zero-dependency TypeScript packages, each published separately on npm. Every package ships its own llms.txt (node_modules/<name>/llms.txt).

## Packages
- [use-live-announcer](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/use-live-announcer/llms.txt): aria-live announcements for screen readers (React hooks + vanilla).
- [envguard](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/envguard/llms.txt): .env loading + validation + TypeScript types (dotenv + envalid replacement).
- [cx-variants](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/cx-variants/llms.txt): cn() + type-safe variants + built-in Tailwind merge (clsx + cva + tailwind-merge replacement).
- [fetch-kit-ts](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/fetch-kit-ts/llms.txt): 2 KB fetch client with retry, timeout, interceptors (axios/ky replacement).
- [duration-i18n](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/duration-i18n/llms.txt): format durations and relative time in any Intl language; parse durations; ms() compatible.
- [tiny-uuidv7](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/tiny-uuidv7/llms.txt): monotonic time-sortable UUIDv7 for database keys.
- [temporal-dates](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/temporal-dates/llms.txt): date-fns-style helpers on the Temporal API (native or polyfill).
- [use-stale-data](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/use-stale-data/llms.txt): React hook — data freshness status and live age.
- [use-throttled-stream](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/use-throttled-stream/llms.txt): React hook — batch WebSocket/SSE streams into throttled state.
- [use-offline-actions](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/use-offline-actions/llms.txt): React hook — offline action queue with retries and sync.
- [use-idle-redirect](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/use-idle-redirect/llms.txt): React hooks — idle warning countdown, auto logout and redirect, cross-tab.
- [use-visibility-polling](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/use-visibility-polling/llms.txt): React hook — polling paused in hidden tabs/offline.
- [use-previous-diff](https://github.com/FeruzDev/toolkit/tree/main/packages/use-previous-diff/llms.txt): React hooks — previous value and deep diff.
